description: Rochester, NY – Today, Sheet Metal Workers International Local 46 endorsed Joe Morelle in the race for the for the 25th Congressional District. Local 46 is comprised of metal and air specialists who have been serving our community for over 100 years.

title: Sheet Metal Workers Endorse Morelle - Joe Morelle for Congress
